title: Largest 3-Same-Digit Number in String
approach: Scan windows of three equal digits
statement: Return the largest substring of three identical digits, or an empty string if none exists.
explanation: Check each length-three window; among windows whose digits match, retain the largest digit.

title: Count Nodes Equal to Average of Subtree
statement: Count nodes whose value equals the integer average of all values in that node’s subtree.
explanation: For each node, return its subtree sum and node count; compare its value with integer division of the sum by the count.

title: Find Resultant Array After Removing Anagrams
statement: Keep the first word and remove each word that is an anagram of the immediately previous kept word.
explanation: Sort each word’s characters to create a signature and append only when the signature differs from the previous kept signature.

title: Percentage of Letter in String
statement: Return the integer percentage of characters in s that equal letter.
explanation: Count occurrences and use integer division of 100 times the count by the string length.

title: Check if Number Has Equal Digit Count and Digit Value
statement: Return true if each digit d in num occurs exactly num[d] times in the string.
explanation: Count digit frequencies, then compare each position’s digit value with that digit’s frequency.

title: Rearrange Characters to Make Target String
statement: Return the maximum number of copies of target that can be formed from s.
explanation: Count each character in s and target; take the minimum available-to-required frequency ratio over target characters.

title: Apply Discount to Prices
statement: Apply the percentage discount to valid price tokens and format them to two decimal places.
explanation: Split on spaces; a token is a price only if it starts with $ and the remaining characters are digits.
example: sentence="there are $1 $2 and 5$ candies", discount=50 -> "there are $0.50 $1.00 and 5$ candies"

title: Min Max Game
statement: Repeatedly replace each adjacent pair with min, max, min, max until one value remains.
explanation: At each round, halve the array and apply min to even-indexed pairs and max to odd-indexed pairs.

title: Calculate Amount Paid in Taxes
statement: Calculate the total tax paid on income using progressive tax brackets.
explanation: For each bracket, tax only the income portion above the previous upper bound and up to the current bound.

title: Greatest English Letter in Upper and Lower Case
approach: Search letters from Z to A
statement: Return the greatest English letter that appears in both uppercase and lowercase, or an empty string.
explanation: Scan letters from Z down to A and return the first whose upper- and lowercase forms both occur.
